heading: Additional regulations for Marine Corps
lead: The President may prescribe military regulations for the discipline of the Marine Corps.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes Revised sectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 601234 U.S.C. 714.R.S. 1620. The words “such” and “as he may deem expedient” are omitted as surplusage.
